text:
`git reset --soft HEAD~1`: undoes the last commit; changes stay staged

variants:
- `git reset HEAD~1` (`--mixed`, default): changes stay in the working tree, unstaged
- `git commit --amend`: edit the last commit in place

already pushed → reset rewrites history; teammates who pulled diverge. Safer: `git revert HEAD` adds a new commit that undoes it.

Do not use `git reset --hard HEAD~1` here. It deletes the changes from the last commit along with any uncommitted work.

recovery: `git reflog` → find the old commit hash → `git reset --soft <hash>` restores it
